title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Package Hold and Return Periods
content:
Received deliveries for a Bluegate Business Storage Account are held at the facility for authorized users to collect. Each program sets three figures: the calendar days a received delivery is held free before storage fees, the storage fee per day per delivery held past that free hold, and the calendar days after receipt after which an uncollected delivery is returned to the sender.

| Program | Free hold (calendar days) | Storage fee per day per delivery held past the free hold | Returned to sender after (calendar days after receipt) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 0 | $0.00 | 0 |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 5 | $1.00 | 14 |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 7 | $1.00 | 21 |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 10 | $2.00 | 30 |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 7 | $1.00 | 21 |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 14 | $1.00 | 30 |

**Remarks.**

- Bluegate Business Essentials does not include delivery acceptance, which is why every figure on its row is zero.
- The storage fee is per delivery and per day, so two deliveries held past their free hold on the same day accrue two daily fees.
- Pro and Fleet carry identical figures. Logistics has the highest daily storage fee, $2.00; every other program that accepts deliveries charges $1.00.
- The return period is measured from the date of receipt, not from the end of the free hold.
